scope: Production shared native music/SFX import lifecycle and bounded ProjectStore Audio transaction: exact old music canonical-data parity, source/project/cancellation ownership, append/rebase and timing/capacity refusal, Undo/Redo/Save As, normalization, history rollback, reentrancy and committed warnings. No audible, browser or hardware equivalence acceptance.

results.name: Retained music blank-project canonical import matches the frozen pre-refactor UI exactly
Retained music existing-score canonical import matches the frozen pre-refactor UI exactly
Music and SFX staging is immutable and preserves authoring, history, emulator and tracker state
SFX appends rebased patterns, instruments and stable IDs while existing music, scenes and settings remain identical
SFX one-Undo import survives Redo and actual Save As/reopen with executable canonical references
Unsupported SFX returns diagnostics without an importable stage or project changes
SFX refuses incompatible project timing or pattern size and never replaces the existing song
Pattern, instrument and SFX capacity and repeated native identity are refused before mutation
Copied, foreign, consumed and stale source/project stages cannot commit
Cancellation and asynchronous source or project changes refuse during revalidation before installation
Changed conversion, malformed source bytes and normalization drift refuse before an Undo entry
Audio owner rejects undeclared fields, modified prefixes, missing guards and unwritable live collections
Audio history snapshot refusal, silence, duplicate recording and post-record exceptions roll back fully
A failed Audio install restores already assigned collections, property descriptors, Undo/Redo and dirty state
Audio detached validation failure and reentrancy release the transaction lock without replacing unrelated owners
Notification failure is an explicit committed warning with dirty and Undoable Audio data
